descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S20 AI check, 10 charts × note and summary: processing does not bring back a deleted item that only stored history still names

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 A deleted medication row, task or Important Point does not reappear on the next day's processing (or any later processing) unless the physician dictates it again. (UAT TC-24; TFA-94699 AC 5; TFA-92590 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U1 A medication row, a task or an Important Point deleted before processing is not included in the summary (the pre-round Save Note result) or in the generated note. (UAT TC-24) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given 10 synthetic stored charts (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home) in the state right after a delete: the deleted row (active, held or stopped), task or point is gone from its list, but the course timeline, yesterday's transcript, the previous visit or the medication events still name it; today's dictation does not. …

When Run each chart through the app's own note action and, separately, through its pre-round processing action

Then No note and no summary re-creates the deleted item as a current medication, task or plan line. Each action passes at 9/10 or better, every failure quoted. Dated-history-only mentions are listed separately (held: Q8).

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-24 bullet 3 + TFA-94699 AC 5 + 3.4, scored per 3.2 (Q9), each action on its own. Per fixture: mustNotInclude the deleted item; re-creating it as a current medication, task or plan line is a Fail. Positive controls (oracleRules 1): 'stable' from today's text, and in the note the fixture's kept medication; …

Where it ran: local aicheck-other (AI output checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from unknown to broken.

Issue type: Ticket not ready for QA · environment local · tickets TFA-92590 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress

After the physician deletes metoprolol from a Hospital patient's medication list, the next pre-round processing writes 'Continue metoprolol' back into the course and background because the old course timeline still mentions it.

Evidence: allure-results/156a2695… (record-only). On main only H1 and H5 can take the stale path. H1 fails: metoprolol is deleted and only the course timeline still names it, yet pre-round processing writes 'Continue metoprolol and anticoagulation' and 'now on metoprolol'. The note half (13 generateNote calls) is held as unauthorised until Quinn gives her OK. The scenario is gated on TFA-94699 AC 5 (TC-24 Q1), and TC-24 Q8 is open. A matrix risk predicted it; it is not in the dev report.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-other.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: aicheck-other.

UAT item: TC-24 Deletions · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-24/S20

AI check, 10 charts × note and summary: processing does not bring back a deleted item that only stored history still names

Tickets: TFA-92590 Important Points (in progress); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane aicheck-other: status record-only in aicheck-other/results.json → needs a person (record only, the lane says it cannot decide / a person decides → a person looks).

How it is tested (aicheck-other/plan.json, automatable: partly): note-ai runner: 10 fixtures; build each chart as the app holds it right after the delete (deleted row gone from the list; stale mention in courseTimeline / transcript from an earlier day / previous notes / meds history) and call (a) ai/notes:generateNote (Hospital template H&P, whose Medications section is mandatory so the kept-medication control is reachable; Nursing Home snf-progress) with patientContext built by the app's own notePatientContext (Hospital, as useNoteGeneration.ts) or noteSnfPatientContext (Nursing Home, as EncounterTab.tsx); (b) the pre-round processing action ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes with today's text (Hospital: preRoundPatientContext/preRoundBackgroundContext; Nursing Home: as useSnfPreRoundProcess.ts) plus refreshCourseAndBackground for the Hospital course. Checks per action: mustNotInclude deleted item (a hit counts as 'held: Q8' only when the sentence has a time marker, is past tense and carries no current directive such as continue/start/on <drug>/now), positive controls ('stable', kept med) else Invalid. passAt 9/10 per action. Each fixture records whether its stale mention can reach the model on main (note: Hospital only; summary: Hospital course timeline only), so a pass that cannot fail is reported as such; the summary's pre-round part is also scored alone (it does not depend on the generated note). — Server actions with app-built context, but the note half (and the Hospital refresh, which is fed the generated note) needs generateNote: generateNote is forbidden on the local stack (capabilities.json 'forbidden: generate', dev only); the runner refuses without QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1, set only after Quinn's OK. The 2026-10-14 note-half calls are held as unauthorised. Also, on main the Nursing Home contexts carry none of the stale sources, so N1-N5 cannot fail (a product fact, recorded).

Detail:

Not decidable today. SUMMARY action (parsePreRoundNotes, + refreshCourseAndBackground for the Hospital course): 9/10 by count (H1 fails), but only H1 and H5 can exercise the stale path on main (course timeline -> pre-round context and refresh): H1 fail, H5 pass. H2-H4 (prior transcript) reach the summary only through the generated note fed to refresh, and N1-N5 never reach the model (on main the Nursing Home note and pre-round contexts carry no previous note text, earlier transcript or medication history), so 8 of the 9 passes cannot fail by construction. The pre-round part alone (no generated note involved) gives the same 9/10 and the same H1 failure. NOTE action: HELD AS UNAUTHORISED (13 generateNote calls on the local stack without Quinn's OK). Read per the oracle it would be undecided: 7 pass (H3 on its re-run, H5, N1-N5 - the last five cannot fail on main), 1 fail (H1), 2 Invalid (H2, H4: the kept-medication control missing twice; with the SOAP template the Plan reads 'Continue current plan' for this dictation), best case 9/10. Runner fixed for the re-run: Hospital note template SOAP -> H&P (mandatory Medications section, so the control is reachable and a re-created deleted medication would show there); the dated-history rule now needs past tense AND no current directive (continue/start/on <drug>/now…), so 'Day 3: continue metoprolol' fails. Rescored from the saved texts with no model calls: counts identical; H1's one 'held: Q8' sentence stays held ('Metoprolol was initiated on day 2 of this admission…'). The note re-run (10 generateNote calls) waits for Quinn's OK on local Generate.

Product issue: Metoprolol is deleted from a Hospital patient's medication list; only the course timeline still says 'Day 2: metoprolol started for rate control'. Today's dictation is 'No acute events overnight, vitals stable, continue current plan.' The pre-round processing (authorised calls) writes the course line 'Continue metoprolol and anticoagulation.' and the background '… now on metoprolol for rate control …'. The generated note (held call, confirm after Quinn's OK) has the Plan line '2. Continue metoprolol for rate control of atrial fibrillation; monitor heart rate and blood pressure response.' with metoprolol absent from the medication list. Breaks UAT TC-24: 'Deleted before processing -> not included in the summary or note' and 'A deleted item does not reappear on the next day's processing unless the physician dictates it again'.

Not authorised, not counted (heldUnauthorised):

  • note half of every fixture (generateNote x10 + x3 re-runs)
  • the Hospital summary's COURSE REFRESH block (refresh is fed the generated note)

Evidence: 4 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (note-ai, preround-ai and course-entry-ai runners, not built): the runner calls ai/notes:generateNote, ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes and ai/notes:refreshCourseAndBackground directly with stored fixtures; on dev the runner calls no action (runner-contract §10.2), so it belongs to the local …. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
